articles.title: We're working on for first uncrewed Gaganyaan mission this year', says Isro chief V Narayanan
articles.summary: ISRO chief V Narayanan confirmed that work is actively progressing on the first uncrewed Gaganyaan mission, aiming for its launch this year. This pivotal test flight is crucial for validating key technologies and systems essential for India's ambitious human spaceflight program, marking a significant milestone in the nation's indigenous space capabilities and future crewed missions.

articles.title: Domestic PCB manufacturing to save Rs 40,000 crore imports annually: Ashwini Vaishnaw
articles.summary: India is set to domestically manufacture Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs), a critical electronics component, aiming to save approximately ₹40,000 crore annually in foreign exchange. This strategic move significantly reduces import dependence, bolstering the 'Make in India' initiative and fostering indigenous capabilities. It underscores India's commitment to self-reliance and economic independence, strengthening national security and development across various vital sectors, including technology and defence applications.
